content.summary: Work items generated from commit plan

work_items.title: Instrument request logging for Opus bad requests
acceptance_criteria: DEBUG log entry emitted before streamText includes provider/model/session/agent/variant and maxOutputTokens.
Log payload includes thinking summary and message/tool counts without prompt content or file data.
Logging is gated by DEBUG level with sensitive headers and options redacted.

work_items.title: Enrich LLM error logging with provider response context
acceptance_criteria: Stream errors log APICallError statusCode and response details when available.
Error logs include the same sanitized request metadata with variant and thinking context.
Sensitive data remains redacted in all error logs.

work_items.title: Align agent.thinking mapping with provider variants and default budgets
acceptance_criteria: agent.thinking defaults use ThinkingEffort budgets when budgetTokens is not provided.
Variant options remain authoritative; no changes to ProviderTransform.variants behavior.
Unit checks or assertions validate default budgets and merge order for thinking options.
